solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Prepare to battle upstream furiously in Alaska? On the contrary

indicators.note: the clue first says the scrambled word goes in the state, telling one piece to sit within the other
this reverses the stated arrangement, so the state's abbreviation goes inside the jumbled letters instead
something done furiously is wild and disordered, so the letters of upstream are thrown into a new order

parts.note: AK is the US postal abbreviation for Alaska

explanation.surface: A salmon, perhaps, gearing up to fight its way upriver in Alaska.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the scrambled word would go in the state; 'On the contrary' flips that, so the state's two letters go inside the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To take up arms is an idiom for getting ready to fight, literally picking up weapons.

clue.text: Warning doctor in row

indicators.note: the doctor is placed in the row, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor in a row of seats is given a warning.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the shout given by a lumberjack as a tree falls.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry is shouted by woodcutters to alert people that a felled tree is coming down.

clue.text: Temperature of 56 in east south-central state

indicators.note: the number is set in the state's abbreviation, one piece inside the other

parts.note: Ken. is an abbreviation of Kentucky, which lies in the US region called East South Central
LVI is 56 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A weather report giving a reading of 56 somewhere in the middle of the USA.
explanation.walkthrough: 'east' looks like a separate E, but the whole phrase 'east south-central state' names Kentucky, from the US Census region of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: A reading on the absolute scale named after Lord Kelvin stands for a temperature, by metonymy.

clue.text: Big foul raven could be allowed no excuses

indicators.note: these words say the letters might become something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A large and nasty raven might be treated as beyond forgiveness.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beyond pardon is a sin for which no excuse will be accepted.

clue.text: Principal structure

definitions.meaning: a curved span built over an opening

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means chief; as a noun it is a curved supporting structure.

clue.text: Fellow feeds a rook having got in for fruit

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: the article and the chess piece get into the word for feeds, sitting inside it

parts.note: to feed is to dine
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A man gives food to a crow that has come inside, all for some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Small citrus oranges of this kind are a fruit; the clue word stands as a plural.

clue.text: In Paris I could go to hospital, heading off unruly fast driver

parts.note: je is French for I

indicators.note: the leading letter of unruly starts it off, so only that initial is used

explanation.surface: A French speaker might go to hospital after a wild driver sets off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' looks like removal, but here it means the head letter, the one leading off.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible King Jehu drove furiously, so his name became a jocular term for a reckless driver.

clue.text: Widespread infection of the outer skin? That's not right

indicators.note: saying the adjective is not right means the letter for right is struck from it

parts.note: epidermic means relating to the epidermis, the outer skin

explanation.surface: A doctor wondering whether a spreading infection is a skin condition, and deciding it is not.
explanation.definitionFit: An outbreak of disease across a community is a widely spreading infection.

clue.text: Pope is said to be such a Continental monarch, with supporting sect

definitions.text: Pope is said to be such

indicators.note: in a down answer a supporting piece sits below, so the group comes after

parts.note: un is French for a
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword monarch
a ring is a closed group or clique

explanation.surface: Claims about papal infallibility set beside a European king and his religious following.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is an adjective phrase: the Pope is held to be infallible, never going wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Catholic doctrine holds the Pope infallible on doctrine, that is, never mistaken.

clue.text: Evil man provided backing, ending with little money

indicators.note: the small coin comes at the close of the answer

parts.note: a man is a male

indicators.note: going backwards, so the word for provided is read in reverse

parts.note: if means provided, as a condition
a cent is a small coin

explanation.surface: A wicked man gave financial support and ended up with only small change.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing harm or wickedness is the meaning, a literary synonym for wicked.

clue.text: Take a risk with girl before church

indicators.note: the girl's name comes ahead of the church

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Proposing to a girl in front of the church is a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to dice means to gamble, as in dicing with death.

clue.text: Elderly minority rushed over to meet Scotsman

parts.note: nonage is legal minority, being under age

indicators.note: turned over, so the word for rushed is reversed

parts.note: ran means rushed
Ian is a typical Scottish name

explanation.surface: Young people hurried across to greet a Scot of advanced years.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in their nineties is certainly elderly, an adjectival use of a word for that age.

clue.text: Eastern fighter concerned with one who's left

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter plane
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A Soviet fighter pilot linked to someone who defected.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who has emigrated, especially for political reasons, has left their homeland.

clue.text: Hereabouts he's left to become a destroyer

indicators.note: the remaining letters turn into something new, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the clue says he has left, so these two letters come out of the pool

explanation.surface: Someone from around here has gone off to serve on a warship.
explanation.walkthrough: Take HE from HEREABOUTS ('he's left') and 'to become' rearranges REABOUTS.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrecker who deliberately damages equipment or plans is one who destroys.

clue.text: Graduate needs capital and artifice, mostly being concerned with pressure in the air

definitions.text: concerned with pressure in the air

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
Rome is the Italian capital

indicators.note: most of the word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: a trick is an artifice

explanation.surface: A graduate needing a big city and some cunning, mostly worried by atmospheric pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Atmospheric pressure is measured with a barometer, hence the adjective relating to it.

clue.text: In expansion getting badly paid leads to ruin

indicators.note: the scrambled pay goes in the word for expansion
the expansion gets the other piece placed within it

parts.note: dilation is widening or expansion

indicators.note: done badly, so the letters of paid are jumbled

explanation.surface: Expanding a business while paying staff poorly leads to its collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of decay or disrepair is ruin, used of buildings falling apart.

clue.text: Bombs ruin delicate finish

parts.note: eggs is slang for bombs, as dropped from aircraft
hell is torment or ruin

explanation.surface: Bombing destroys a fragile paint job.
explanation.definitionFit: A paint finish with a faint sheen, and the delicate shell of an egg, share this name.

clue.text: Instrument nun keeps at home to accompany tenor

indicators.note: the voice letter goes alongside, at the end
the nun holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a Poor Clare is a nun of the order of St Clare
in means at home

explanation.surface: A nun stays in, playing an instrument beside a tenor singer.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodwind with a single reed is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Avenge mortal that's destroyed what may determine the flow of power

definitions.text: what may determine the flow of power

indicators.note: words destroyed are broken apart and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: Taking revenge on a mortal who has wrecked a power line.
explanation.definitionFit: This instrument measures electric current, so it determines how strongly power flows.

clue.text: Disclose one in merrymaking

indicators.note: one is put inside the word for merrymaking

parts.note: a revel is a bout of merrymaking
a means one

explanation.surface: Letting slip a secret about one person at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: To make known something hidden is to disclose it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Playful, loud and dangerous

parts.note: F is forte, the musical abbreviation for loud
risky means dangerous

explanation.surface: Someone frolicsome, noisy and a bit of a hazard.
explanation.definitionFit: Lively and full of high spirits, as a frolicking pet or child is.

clue.text: Child's vehicle holy man placed in front of car

indicators.note: the holy man goes ahead of the car

parts.note: St, saint, is a holy man
Roller is slang for a Rolls-Royce car

explanation.surface: A pram set down by a saint ahead of a car.
explanation.walkthrough: A Roller is British slang for a Rolls-Royce.
explanation.definitionFit: A pushchair, the American word for a baby buggy, is a vehicle for a child.

clue.text: Tear shown by minister to Queen

parts.note: to minister to is to tend or care
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: A clergyman weeping when presented to the Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tear' reads as weeping, but it is the verb meaning to rush along.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush headlong at speed is to tear along; the verb career means the same.

clue.text: Only a small pond

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means nothing more than; as a noun it is a small lake or pond.

clue.text: Wise to get out iron initially for an eagle

indicators.note: the letter is made to leave the comedian's first name

parts.note: Ernie Wise was the comedian partner of Eric Morecambe

indicators.note: only the first letter of iron is meant

explanation.surface: A sage advised to take iron away for an eagle.
explanation.walkthrough: Morecambe and Wise were a famous British comedy double act; Ernie Wise was the short one.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a sea eagle, a crossword favourite for the bird.

clue.text: Windy state of Elizabeth, having to hold on and, in short, book in

indicators.note: the final word puts the magazine piece inside the name as well
the name holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: Bess is a pet form of Elizabeth
re means on, about

indicators.note: the clipped, familiar form of the word is meant, so its front is cut away

parts.note: a magazine is called a book in the publishing trade

explanation.surface: Elizabeth's cheerful manner as she holds on and checks in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book' in the trade sense is a magazine, and 'in short' trims it to its familiar clipped form; both inserts land at different points of the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Being windy or gusty is the literal sense, here a state of the weather.

clue.text: Strip seen in Senegal at harvest-feast

indicators.note: the letters can be seen inside the run of words

explanation.surface: A strip of land noticed at a West African harvest celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin strip of wood, as used under plaster, is the meaning.

clue.text: Perhaps showing around even Poland in wake of credit for script

indicators.note: the word for perhaps shows itself around the other pieces

parts.note: say means perhaps, for example

indicators.note: the later pieces follow on after credit

parts.note: e'en is a poetic contraction of even
PL is the abbreviation for Poland

explanation.surface: A film showing in Poland following the credits, for the script.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' is the familiar 'say' (as in 'for example'), and 'even' is its poetic contraction e'en.
explanation.definitionFit: The written text of a film, with dialogue and directions, is its script.
